16                REVEREND DeJESUS:   Good afternoon, 

17   everyone.  

18                As a pastor who was born and raised 

19   here in the great State of New York, I'm honored 

20   and privileged to have been invited by Senator 

21   Kaminsky to lead today's session in prayer.  

22                So please join me as we come before 

23   He who sits on the throne high and lifted up.  

24   Let us pray.  

25                Heavenly Father, we humbly come 


                                                                3130

 1   before Your throne of grace and mercy.  And Lord, 

 2   we thank You, for we know that Your eyes are open 

 3   and Your ears are attentive to the prayer that is 

 4   made from this chamber.  

 5                Lord, we thank You for the privilege 

 6   You have given us to serve the people of New York 

 7   for such a time as this.  Your word exhorts us to 

 8   offer prayers for all that are in authority, that 

 9   we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all 

10   godliness and honesty, for this is good and 

11   acceptable in Your sight.  

12                And so today we pray for the work of 

13   this legislative body, every Senator and their 

14   support staff.  God, we ask that You bless them 

15   with good health and prosperity.  Give them the 

16   strength to walk before You in faithfulness, in 

17   righteousness, and in uprightness of heart toward 

18   You.  

19                Give them an understanding mind to 

20   govern Your people, that they may discern between 

21   good and evil so that Your people can perceive 

22   that the wisdom of God is in them to do justice.  

23                Give them the courage that they need 

24   to make the decisions they've been empowered to 

25   make for the betterment of each community.  And 


                                                                3131

 1   help us understand that whatever we do for one of 

 2   the least of our brothers and sisters, we do it 

 3   for You.

 4                Unite us, and tear down the 

 5   strongholds that divide us, so that this season 

 6   be one of great prosperity for our state.  

 7                Respectfully, I ask these things in 

 8   Jesus' name.  Amen.

13                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Thank you, 

14   Mr. President.

15                You know, this bill is very similar 

16   to a law that was in the press in the last week 

17   or two involving 485-a.  This would be an 

18   expansion of 485-r.  And what we learned with 

19   485-a was that in the City of Syracuse, 

20   40 properties were approved under a similar 

21   program and cost the city I think $50 million in 

22   lost tax revenue for incredibly minor adjustments 

23   to the property.

24                This is a bit different, and again 

25   it's at local option.  But my concern is it would 


                                                                3149

 1   actually allow people to buy a house that had 

 2   perhaps almost no value, tear it down, and then 

 3   get 25 years tax-free on the increased value of 

 4   the land from building a house.

 5                Now, I understand why localities 

 6   would want old homes that are no longer sellable 

 7   to be torn down.  But the concept of a 

 8   100 percent tax exemption for 25 years translates 

 9   into other people in the area having to pay more 

10   property tax for 25 years to make up for that 

11   lost property tax.

12                So I think it goes too far.  This 

13   would take an existing law that applies to one 

14   small town and apply it to the entire state -- 

15   again, at local option.  I'm hoping most 

16   localities will think through this carefully if 

17   it becomes law.  

18                But I'll vote no, Mr. President.  

19   Thank you.
